title: Norton Cleaner – Junk removal
summary: Clean up your photo library. Delete junk and clutter. Optimize your device.
description:
Norton Cleaner is the mobile version of Norton Utilities Ultimate (NUU).
Already subscribed? Just sign in to access your subscription at no extra cost.

Norton Cleaner is a clean-up app that will help you reclaim storage space on your Android device by cleaning junk and removing residual files.

Don’t have enough storage to take more pictures or install apps? Norton, the world's leading cyber security software provider, now sweeps your memory cache and storage clean of residual and junk files to remove clutter from your Android device.

Keep your Android device running like new. Your phone is more than just a device—it’s your connection to family, friends, and memories. Norton Utilities Ultimate for Android helps you keep it running smoothly by freeing up space and optimizing its performance.

Install Norton Cleaner app cleaner to remove junk and free up space on your Android device:

✔ Clean and clear cache
✔ Tidy up your photos 
✔ Identify and remove junk, APK, and residual files
✔ Free up memory
✔ Manage apps and get rid of bloatware
✔ Set it and forget it with Auto-Cleaning 

--------------------------------------------------

NORTON CLEANER FEATURES

✸ Deep Clean 
◦ Deep clean to free up more space: Remove hidden junk files to regain storage space for what matters to you.
◦ Works as a cache cleaner that helps clean residual cache system files often left by uninstalled apps.
◦ Includes junk remover / storage cleaner that helps analyze, cleanup and safely remove the junk files that take up your memory and storage space.
◦ Works as an app cleaner that helps you clean cache for individual apps.

✸ Browser Cleaner 
◦ Boost privacy with browser cleaning
◦ Clear browsing history, including cache and downloads folder, to improve your privacy and make it harder to track your online activity

✸ Auto Cleaning 
◦ Auto-clean your device to reclaim more space
◦ Schedule custom cleaning to automatically remove junk files, photos, and downloads. Set it up once, then relax, knowing that we’ve got you covered

✸ Media Overview 
◦ Clean up your media library 
◦ Find and delete unwanted, bad, duplicate, or similar photos, images, screenshots, and large videos. If your photos are too precious to remove, compress them

✸ Photo Optimizer
◦ Compress photos to save storage 
◦ Free up space by compressing large photos that are too precious to be removed

✸ Sleep Mode
◦ Optimize your device for important tasks by turning off unused apps and their notifications

✸ Apps Overview 
◦ Find and stop draining apps
◦ Find, turn off, or remove apps you don’t use and factory-reset preinstalled bloatware that keep stealing your space and performance

✸ Custom dashboard
◦ Keep favorite actions close 
◦ Personalize your dashboard with custom shortcuts for quick access to your favorite actions and info

✸ Quick Clean 
◦ One-tap cleanup for instant results
◦ Scan your Android device and quickly identify clutter you can remove across multiple categories

This app uses Accessibility permission to assist disabled and other users stop all background apps with just one tap.
